facts.detail: Ofcom published The Communications Market 2026 on 30 June 2026.
The Communications Market Report is provided as an interactive data portal.
The portal combines data collected from industry, Ofcom consumer research and selected third-party headline figures.
Ofcom directs users to Media Nations, Online Nation and Connected Nations for commentary and analysis of much of the data.
The publication provides a telecoms-data CSV among its downloadable datasets.

facts.detail: Ofcom last updated the ADR schemes performance page on 23 July 2026.
Ofcom publishes quarterly KPI results for CISAS and Communications Ombudsman.
Updated ADR performance KPIs apply from the fourth quarter of 2025.
For Q2 2026, Communications Ombudsman reported 95% of calls answered within two minutes and 99% of case decisions reached within six weeks.
For Q2 2026, CISAS reported 99% of calls answered within two minutes and 97% of case decisions reached within six weeks.

facts.detail: Ofcom last updated the Communications Affordability Tracker on 14 May 2026.
The tracker covers affordability experiences for home broadband, mobile phone, landline and pay-TV services.
The current page presents an April 2026 affordability-tracker chart series.
The financial-vulnerability grouping combines household income, working status and household size.
Ofcom states that the chart data can be downloaded through its statistical release calendars.

facts.detail: Ofcom last updated its Contracts guidance on 26 June 2026.
A contract may use a fixed monthly price or a clearly specified price increase on a stated date.
Disabled customers can request contract information in a reasonably acceptable accessible format such as large print or Braille.
Ofcom advises checking additional charges such as early termination, paper billing, roaming and cancellation-notice costs.
For a small business with ten employees or fewer, a provider must obtain consent before each new minimum landline or broadband contract period.

facts.detail: Ofcom last updated its affordability-of-communications-services overview on 4 February 2026.
Ofcom identifies affordable fixed broadband and mobile internet access as a priority.
Ofcom has published affordability and social-tariff updates since December 2020.
The overview directs users to the Pricing Trends in Communication Services report for the latest affordability and social-tariff data.
Ofcom uses its Communications Affordability Tracker to assess changing consumer attitudes and behaviours about affordability.
